messages.subject: gl.nhybrids selecting 191 loci instead of 200
parts:
Hi there,

I have a question about the gl.nhybrids command. When I use method="AvgPIC", it selects 200. However, when I ask for random loci, it always selects 191. See the output below. 

> gl.nhybrids(gl99, outfile="nhyb_may2020b.txt")

    Selecting ca 200 random loci

   Note: SNP metadata discarded

  NumIndivs  234 
  NumLoci  191  
  Digits 1
  Format Lumped 
gl.nhybrids Completed
NULL

> gl.nhybrids(gl99, outfile="nhyb_may2020b.txt", outpath="/Volumes/CarolineDong/Dropbox/PhD Projects/2 Contact zone/Analysis/dartR/", p0=c("NFR", "OR", "SFR"), p1=c("LR", "KI"))

Please let me know if you have any suggestions, thank you!

Cheers
Caroline
